description: Supervisory checks on agent runs, fired at specific lifecycle triggers. The default path uses bounded one-shot LLM checks for plan, edit, watchdog, and commit review. Opt-in Managed build contracts instead use Agent Orchestration for a tool-free Run Scout, a persistent source-read-only edit reviewer, and two fresh independent close auditors. Contract requests and verdicts are schema-validated, generation-fenced, budgeted, persisted with evidence hashes, and visibly fail open on worker infrastructure errors under the default hybrid policy. Valid blocking edit and close findings retain the existing correction and three-block safe-stop behavior. Both modes require the manager_chk loop node and the run_manager app function; subagent contracts additionally require the Agent Orchestration ability. The mechanical metadata['contract'] remains a separate zero-LLM layer.
_note: App function (supervisory service with async checks and optional blocking gates), not an agent ability. Its runtime lives in app/agent/manager.py, which gates every check on app_function_enabled('run_manager') and reads per-trigger prompts from app_level_prompts.manager_<kind> in app-prompts.json (per-agent metadata['manager_<kind>_prompt'] overrides). Descriptor-only by design — no <id>.py.
